results.releaseNotes:
• Background App Refresh: O₂ Buddy now appears under Settings → General → Background App Refresh, so iOS can wake the app for new readings while it's closed. A new onboarding step and a one-time reminder help you turn it on.
• Keep Readings Flowing guide: clearer steps for the Shortcuts automation, including the Apple Intelligence screen and what to search for.
• Settings shows a warning when Background App Refresh is off.
• Smaller widget extension.
results.description:
O₂ Buddy makes your blood oxygen readings effortless to see, understand, and track - on your iPhone, your Home Screen, and your wrist.

Your Apple Watch already measures your blood oxygen throughout the day and night. O₂ Buddy turns those readings into something you can actually use.

AT A GLANCE
• Your latest reading, a Last Night summary, and today's average and low on one screen
• Every reading is grouped as Typical, Lower, or Low, so you know where it falls instantly

SEE YOUR TRENDS
• Switch between 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, and 90 days with a tap
• Every day shows its full range alongside its average, so you see the whole picture - not just the last number
• Watch your average rise or fall compared to the period before

DAY VS NIGHT
• Compare your daytime readings against your overnight ones, side by side
• If you track sleep in Health, "night" means asleep - and each night is counted on the morning it ends, not split at midnight

INSIGHTS
• Time in range: how much of your period was Typical, Lower, or Low
• Your pattern by hour of day, and your lowest readings

EVERY READING IN CONTEXT
• Tap any reading to see where it falls within that day
• See your heart rate from the five minutes before and after, and your breathing rate when it was measured
• Compare it against readings taken around the same time on other days

SHARE WITH YOUR DOCTOR
• Export a clean PDF report or a spreadsheet of up to 90 days of readings
• Reports are created on your iPhone and only leave it if you choose to share them

ON YOUR WRIST
• A fast, glanceable Apple Watch app: your latest reading, then a 7-day trend with daily ranges
• Your last 100 readings on the wrist
• Complications in circular, rectangular, corner, and inline styles - including a color-coded gauge ring and a 7-day trend sparkline

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
• A widget for your latest reading
• A widget for your 7-day trend

LOW READING NOTICES
• Optional notifications when a reading falls below a threshold you choose
• Readings that arrive together after you unlock your iPhone become one summary, with the time each was taken

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Read-only access to Apple Health
• Your data stays on your devices - never uploaded, never shared, never sold

O₂ BUDDY PRO
Readings and today's overview are free. Trends, Day vs Night, low reading notices, the full Watch app and complications, vitals, Insights, and Export are part of O₂ Buddy Pro - a single one-time purchase, not a subscription. If you bought O₂ Buddy before version 2.0, everything you already had stays yours at no cost, and the 2.0 additions are offered at a reduced founder price. An optional tip jar is also available; tips unlock nothing.

Also includes Light, Dark, and Automatic appearance, 12- or 24-hour time, and built-in FAQs and support.

O₂ Buddy is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose or treat any condition. Blood oxygen measurements are recorded by Apple Watch and stored in the Health app.
